cards.en: an unexpected problem that delays progress
cards.example: The launch hit a setback, so we moved it to Friday.
cards.translation: El lanzamiento sufrió un contratiempo, así que lo pasamos al viernes.
cards.prompt: The launch hit a ___, so we moved it to Friday.

cards.en: to make something harmful less severe
cards.example: We added a backup to mitigate the risk of losing data.
cards.translation: Añadimos una copia de seguridad para reducir el riesgo de perder datos.
cards.prompt: We added a backup to ___ the risk of losing data.

cards.en: a difference between things that should agree
cards.example: There is a discrepancy between the invoice and the quote.
cards.translation: Hay una discrepancia entre la factura y el presupuesto.
cards.prompt: There is a ___ between the invoice and the quote.

cards.es: imprevisto; posibilidad para la que conviene prepararse
cards.en: a possible future event that needs a plan
cards.example: We have a contingency plan if the supplier is late.
cards.translation: Tenemos un plan para imprevistos por si el proveedor se retrasa.
cards.prompt: We have a ___ plan if the supplier is late.

cards.en: a mistake made by failing to notice something
cards.example: The missing attachment was an oversight, not a change of plan.
cards.translation: El adjunto que faltaba fue un descuido, no un cambio de plan.
cards.prompt: The missing attachment was an ___, not a change of plan.

cards.en: a point that slows down a process
cards.example: The approval step has become a bottleneck for the whole team.
cards.translation: La fase de aprobación se ha convertido en un cuello de botella para todo el equipo.
cards.prompt: The approval step has become a ___ for the whole team.

cards.en: to give time, money or resources for a particular purpose
cards.example: We will allocate two hours to staff training.
cards.translation: Destinaremos dos horas a la formación del personal.
cards.prompt: We will ___ two hours to staff training.

cards.es: auditoría; revisión oficial de las cuentas
cards.en: an official examination of financial records
cards.example: An independent audit will check whether the accounts are accurate.
cards.translation: Una auditoría independiente comprobará si las cuentas son correctas.
cards.prompt: An independent ___ will check whether the accounts are accurate.

cards.es: déficit; diferencia cuando se gasta más de lo que se ingresa
cards.en: the amount by which spending is greater than income
cards.example: Spending exceeded income, leaving a deficit of €5,000.
cards.translation: Los gastos superaron los ingresos y dejaron un déficit de 5.000 €.
cards.prompt: Spending exceeded income, leaving a ___ of €5,000.
